name: Shugo Chara! Amu no Niji-iro Chara Change
original_name: しゅごキャラ！ あむのにじいろキャラチェンジ
source:
It's a raising sim where Amu must develop her relationship with any of the available characters (the Guardians, Ikuto, Utau, Nikaidou and Nagihiko) during three months, with the target of bringing a partner to the "Best Friends Festival."

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugo_Chara!#Video_games]Wikipedia[/url]]
